purpose: Validate pre-research claim classification, Exa evidence boundaries, freshness/conflict checks, and OTA vs KUE-SCI publication routing on three existing OTA documents.

cases.research_question: Which claims in OTA-SCI-0037 about the 2026 RHIC/STAR result, Lambda-anti-Lambda spin correlation, the quantum vacuum and the interpretation as transfer from virtual to real states are supported by the primary publication and subsequent/current literature, and which are model-dependent, overstated, speculative, or superseded?
cases.real_world_anchor: STAR/RHIC primary result, measured spin correlations, accepted quantum-field interpretation, and subsequent scientific discussion.
expected_behavior: Use primary/peer-reviewed literature and check for later publications, corrections and counterinterpretations.
Do not treat Omnizedenz/AVI framing as experimentally established.
If a standalone real-world analysis is warranted, recommend a separable KUE-SCI e-paper on kueper.com and leave OTA/canon framing in OTA.

cases.research_question: For OTA-FND-0030, which real-physics premises and constraints relevant to the AVI reference layer are established or testable, and where do the NOXIA-specific Hexade, chi-index and resonance-technology extensions cross from theoretical/hypothetical material into speculation, work-setting or fiction?
cases.real_world_anchor: Standard cosmology/quantum-vacuum background and any externally testable premises or constraints used by the AVI reference layer.
expected_behavior: Research R and the external premises/constraints of T/H/S only.
Do not search for evidence that Hexade, chi-index or NOXIA canon is 'true'.
Keep the mixed foundational document in OTA; only a separately reviewable real-science treatment may later be promoted to KUE-SCI.

cases.research_question: Does OTA-BIO-0026 contain a genuinely external ethnographic, linguistic, geographic or scientific anchor that needs verification, as distinct from the fictional character dossier itself?
expected_behavior: The discovery gate must not queue a pure F/W request merely to validate the character or canon.
External research is allowed only if a concrete real-world anchor is first identified and reclassified as R-Anker/R.
No KUE-SCI recommendation is expected from character-canon validation.

success_criteria: Claim classes exist before Exa/web research begins.
F/W-only material without a real-world anchor does not enter external research.
T/H/S evidence is used for constraints and falsifiability, not as automatic validation.
Material newer or contradictory evidence is surfaced explicitly.
Real scientific e-paper recommendations point to thomaspeterkueper/kueper.com/src/content/kue/sci with KUE-SCI namespace.
No pilot run directly edits OTA, kueper.com, or canonical Knowledge Graph data.
